artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 24.2 x 17.8 cm (9 1/2 x 7 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He has a solemn expression with detailed features such as a straight nose, prominent cheekbones, and engaging eyes. His hair is short and wavy, framing his face. He wears an outfit with a high collar, buttons, and decorative patterns on the sleeves. The man holds a pointed instrument in his right hand and a square object with a patterned cover in his left hand. The background features mythological creatures and ornate decorations. An inscription in cursive script is at the bottom of the image. The composition is in a monochromatic palette with detailed line work typical of an engraving.

artworks.title: Floral Still Life with a Sunflower
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 18.2 x 14.4 cm (7 3/16 x 5 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a bouquet of flowers, including a large sunflower and smaller flowers, leaves, and buds inside a detailed vase. The vase is placed centrally on a flat surface, with the flowers extending outwards. It is rendered in grayscale tones against a black background.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a cross in a religious scene. The image depicts a somber scene with a group of figures surrounding a cross, which appears central in the composition. At the center, a lifeless body is being gently lowered from the cross, supported by multiple figures. The cross is set against a sky filled with clouds. A crown of thorns is visible on the ground in front of the figures. The garments of the figures and the style of the linework suggest classical or Renaissance artistic influences. The scene emphasizes themes of mourning and reverence.

artworks.title: Two Tramps, a Man and a Woman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lt. Col. and Mrs. William K. Konze
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking closely together. One person is slightly ahead, leaning forward with a walking stick for support, while the other is following closely behind, slightly hunched. Both individuals have minimal facial features and heads covered. They are wearing loose-fitting clothing and the person in front has a long-sleeved garment and a long skirt, while the person behind wears a hat. The background is simple with abstract shapes hinting at distant flora or landscape.

artworks.title: Travelers on the Sands near Redcar
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache over graphite with scratching out
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with two figures on horseback riding along the beach. In the background, there is a castle or fortress on the horizon. The shoreline runs diagonally from rocky cliffs on the left to the water on the right. The sea is calm with gentle waves breaking on the sand. The sky above is filled with wispy clouds. The painting has a soft and light color palette, including sandy browns, muted purples, soft blues, deep greens, and whites.

artworks.title: Supplement to "L'Omnibus de Corinthe"
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted in a sketch-like drawing style. Both figures are shown with only their heads and shoulders visible, facing each other in close proximity. The person on the left has short, wavy hair styled closely to the head and features sharp, attentive eyes and a pronounced nose. Their mouth is slightly open. They wear a high-collared garment. The person on the right has long hair styled into a loose bun at the top of the head and displays delicate facial features, with closed eyes and a subtle smile. This person holds a small, cup-like object to their lips, from which a tiny omnibus is emerging. There is no visible jewelry on either figure. Above them, the words "OMNIBUS de CORINTHE" are prominently featured. The background of the illustration is plain. Additional text in a decorative script runs along the bottom and side.

artworks.title: Salamander (La Salamandre)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a vine with leaves extending from the upper right corner towards the center, with a small insect positioned slightly below the vine to the left. The color palette is primarily light beige and soft gray. The vine cascades diagonally from the top right, while the insect is placed lower and to the left of the vine.

artworks.title: Sagot
artworks.medium: woodcut on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of individuals standing in front of an art gallery. The artwork depicts a crowd of people with their backs turned, wearing dark coats and hats while standing outside a venue marked by signage that includes the name "Ed. SAGOT" and an address in Paris. The bold contrast of black and white is achieved through woodcut printmaking, creating distinct silhouettes and an emphasis on patterns like the checked overcoat of one figure. The scene suggests a bustling atmosphere, with handwritten elements adding a personal touch to the depiction.

artworks.title: Woman Floating in a River Attended by Two Female Spirits
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite heightened with white and touches of orange on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and curved shapes forming an abstract scene with three figures in the center. The background features shadowy lines resembling trees and water.

artworks.title: Woman Floating in a River Attended by Several Female Spirits
artworks.medium: charcoal with spattering on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective with foliage and trees in the distance aligned with the horizon. The drawing uses soft, blurred strokes, likely charcoal or pencil. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of brown and black. Close towards us are faint outlines of figures in misty surroundings, with spindly vegetation rising and grassy elements present.

artworks.title: Ancient Sculptures with a Cock Fighting a Snake
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large urn on a pedestal surrounded by a tree. The colors are monochrome in various shades of grey and black, as it is a pencil drawing. A rooster stands in the foreground next to broken architectural fragments. In the middle ground, a person holds a vase above their head amidst tree branches, and smaller architectural elements are visible behind them.

artworks.title: Ile de la Cité from the Institut, Paris
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lowell Libson in honor of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of an urban scene. The point of view is from street level, focusing on the architectural elements of a city. On the right is a large, detailed building with classical columns and arches, topped with sculptures. Several figures are visible, with umbrellas. In the distance, there are various buildings with different rooftops defining the skyline. The sketch is composed of light pencil strokes and soft shading, with a monochromatic color palette of soft gray tones. It captures a quiet everyday moment in an old European city.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Lowell Libson
artworks.description: The image is a painting depicting a landscape scene with a low horizon. A dirt path winds through the scene, bordered by fences. To the left, a group of tall trees with thick canopies is depicted. The painting uses soft brushstrokes and muted earth tones in the color palette, including rustic browns, soft greens, misty blues, and a soft sky in blues and grays.

artworks.title: A Standing Saint
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, facing slightly to the side with their head tilted forward. The person has deep-set eyes, a bushy beard, and thick, curly hair. They are wearing flowing garments with a cloak fastened over one shoulder, depicted with loose, expressive lines. In their right hand, they are holding a staff upright. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving multiple figures surrounding a large cross. The drawing showcases an intricate composition of dynamic figures in motion, some appearing to be in flight, while others are engaged in animated gestures. The central element of the drawing is a group of figures interacting around a large cross, with various expressions and postures suggesting movement and action. The figures are sketched in a manner that suggests spontaneity and flowing lines, capturing a sense of drama and emotion. The overall scene is rich with interplay of lines that hint at a narrative or symbolic significance.

artworks.title: Saint Vincent Ferrer Taking His Vestments
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in historical attire. The composition features a kneeling figure surrounded by other figures. The scene is set in a grand architectural interior with columns and elaborate details. The style is reminiscent of Girolamo da Carpi, characterized by loosely rendered forms and dynamic postures. Contrast and shading add depth and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Hercules Slaying the Hydra
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows two nude figures in dynamic poses, each holding a large club above their head. The figures have detailed facial features and curly hair, and are depicted in motion. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. The artwork is rendered in sepia tones on textured paper.

artworks.title: Women and Children at a Fountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper, mounted on an old album sheet
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 32 × 26.8 cm (12 5/8 × 10 9/16 in.)
sheet with architectural border: 33.9 × 39.4 cm (13 3/8 × 15 1/2 in.)
mount: 43.2 × 52 cm (17 × 20 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of classical figures gathered around a basin. The sepia-toned image depicts figures draped in flowing garments reminiscent of ancient Roman or Greek styles, with an architectural element in the background resembling a balustrade or a similar structure. The scene is framed by ornate, scrolling designs that include mythological creatures. The detailed shading of the robes and the rendering of the figures indicate a focus on classical art techniques. The lower part of the drawing includes an inscription identifying the artist.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash with white gouache over black chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting figures in motion and struggle, with horses and riders in the forefront. The composition includes flowing drapery, helmets, shields, banners, and a chiaroscuro technique to create depth.

artworks.title: Le Poilu (French Soldier Writing Home)
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a person seated in a crouched position, with their upper body hunched forward. The individual is shown in profile from the waist up, resting one elbow on their knee and holding either their face or hat brim. The person's facial features are obscured by shading. They wear a hat and a long-sleeved garment, and appear to be focused on writing, holding a writing instrument while looking at a surface in front of them. The sketch-style illustration features minimal background, with the artist's signature visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Das leere Café (The Empty Café)
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of stumping on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a café interior. It depicts various furnishings and architectural elements. The drawing is executed in pencil or charcoal, creating a monochromatic and textured appearance. There is a row of round tables and chairs to the left, arranged in diminishing perspective, leading deeper into the café. In the foreground, there is a person not fully detailed, giving the scene a sketch-like quality. On the right, other tables and chairs are spaced throughout the room. The ceiling features a chandelier or hanging lights for illumination. The ambiance is quiet, capturing the essence of an early 20th-century café setting. Shading and line work are used to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Das leere Café (The Empty Café)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with crayons on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains swirling and intersecting lines, creating an abstract scene on the paper. The curved shapes and meandering lines hint at the contour of a room with tables and chairs. Angular lines and round shapes suggest the presence of objects or people like hats or lamps. The use of vibrant colors like red, yellow, and blue adds energy to the composition.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with Country Folk from Appenzell
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash on laid paper, squared for transfer and mounted on an old album sheet
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 29.5 x 41.5 cm (11 5/8 x 16 5/16 in.)
overall (album sheet): 40.9 x 53.7 cm (16 1/8 x 21 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men gathered outdoors. Several men are seated while others stand around them. The central figure, seated on the left, is shown in profile, resting his chin in his hand, wearing simple, loose clothing with a hat, and holding a stick in his other hand. His features are drawn with narrow eyes and a prominent nose, with short hair showing beneath the hat. To his right, another seated man faces forward, leaning slightly with his elbows on knees, wearing similar attire with a head covering and holding a cane or stick. Standing around them, a few other men are shown in discussion, engaged with one another, each dressed in typical rural wear of the time, including simple shirts and pants, some wearing hats or caps. The background features a sparsely detailed landscape with a few trees, depicted in a sketch-like manner, giving an impression of a natural, open-air setting. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or other objects apart from the canes or sticks some figures hold.

artworks.title: A Windmill against a Cloudy Sky
artworks.medium: oil paint and black chalk over charcoal on tan paper
